init.title: Connection
init.description: Each light accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time. While Home Assistant holds a light, the L Home app cannot connect to that light. A short time keeps the L Home app usable; a longer time makes repeated Home Assistant commands faster (no reconnect). With 2 or more lights you can set 0 to keep Home Assistant connected to one light all the time (fastest commands, reconnects by itself); the L Home app then uses another light.

data.idle_disconnect: Release the light after this many idle seconds (0 = stay connected)

data_description.idle_disconnect: 0, or 10-600 seconds. Default 10. 0 keeps one light connected permanently and uses one connection slot of the ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
